secondary_sales.reading: USDat secondary-sale liquidity was supported at the tested route size on both Ethereum and Monad. The unresolved upstream steps are srUSDat conversion or transport and withdrawal settlement; these tests did not demonstrate USDat illiquidity.
secondary_sales.limits: Dated size-specific observations, not current capacity, delivery or a complete cash exit. Fresh quotes and authorization are required. Primary issuer redemption is a separate alternative, not a prerequisite for these secondary sales.

exit_stages.name: srUSDat conversion / transport
exit_stages.reading: A supported local Monad srUSDat-to-USDat conversion remains unestablished. Strata LayerZero share transport and Saturn CCIP token migration are separate dependencies; bridge delivery is not established by a quote.

exit_stages.name: Tranche cooldown
exit_stages.reading: A zero tranche cooldown does not mean immediate USDat delivery. A share preview or enabled tranche action is not settlement.

exit_stages.name: Underlying Saturn withdrawal queue
exit_stages.reading: The reviewed strategy routes USDat withdrawal through unstakeCooldown and an asynchronous Saturn queue. Current queue eligibility and completion timing are unknown. A direct sUSDat-share output is a distinct path with its own configuration.

exit_stages.name: Final USDat secondary sale
exit_stages.reading: Ethereum and Monad USDat-to-USDC quotes support the tested sale leg. They do not establish upstream token delivery, holder funding/permissions or the final swap executing.

valuation.reading: Liquidation health factors use the protocol oracle, including its exchange-rate or NAV valuation and thresholds. NAV or exchange-rate impairment can reduce health even when a secondary quote is near par. A market discount can increase unwind cost without an immediate oracle/HF change; oracle updates can later transmit it. Both risks need separate evidence.
valuation.scope: Tranche coverage is not a lending health factor. Neither oracle/NAV coverage nor HF guarantees executable sale proceeds, queue completion or cash settlement.

coverage_gaps: No continuous holder-route or queue eligibility/timing feed.
